page.overview:
Who is Maxim Dubrov?

Maxim Dubrov was a slave master and co-host of the The Harkonnen Family Games.

Maxim Dubrov hosted The Harkonnen Family Games alongside Vera Kotilla on the Communinet Radio station of House Harkonnen. They commentated a confrontation between Poyko Nen and the Grey Lady in the challenge known as the Man Trap. Maxim criticised Poyko's cowardice and mocked the Grey Lady's scarred and disfigured face once her veil was torn off during the fight. Kanto's rock lizards entered the arena and tore Poyko to pieces, which Maxim considered a deserving fate for a coward.
